designations.eng: Spectral width at half maximum value

eng: Spectral width at half maximum value

terms.designation: Spectral width at half maximum value

definitions.content: Difference between a higher and lower wavelength value at which the value of an optical quantity is reduced to half of its maximum value between the two wavelengths.

notes.content: The coherent SI unit is the metre (m), but often the nanometre (nm) is used.
The optical quantity can be e.g. radiant luminous flux, absorbance, etc.
